<a id="summary"></a>

## Summary

Any seat may add a role and spawn a seat in it; pij tells the project's prime once each time, without waking it. A seat that is unsure records a suggestion instead; the prime's view lists open ones and the prime answers each.

<a id="goals"></a>

## Goals

- The prime knows every seat and role created in its project, and every unowned area a seat spotted.

<a id="non-goals"></a>

## Non-goals

- Refusing anyone on the grounds of who is asking.

## Risks

<a id="execution-guardrails"></a>

## Execution Guardrails

- Cost: on demand: one FYI per non-prime add or spawn; suggest and answer are one writer commit each. No loop, poll or timer.
- No permission rule changes (PRD 003); no daemon enforcement of a type's rules; no existing JSON field removed or renamed.
- Builds nice-19 through `just shared-build`, one at a time.
